## Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
#### [DeepSeek-v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434) [14] and [DeepSeek-V3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19437) [15]
Authors in [14] also adopt an interesting load balancing strategy for handling the fine-grained experts used by DeepSeek-v2.

An **auxiliary-loss-free load balancing** strategy is also used by DeepSeek-v3 that simply adds a per-expert bias term to the selection of Top-`K` experts; see above.

# Mixture of Experts in Large Language Models: Intuition, Methods, and System Design
## Structure:
- **Load Balancer:** Auxiliary loss ensuring experts are used evenly.

## 4.3 Load Balancing
- **Auxiliary balancing loss**: Encourages uniform token distribution.
- **Z-loss**: Penalizes overconfident routing.
- **Entropy regularization**: Encourages diverse expert use.
